convert_nvm_to_ply: run the script to convert a VisualSfM NVM reconstruction file to a PLY point cloud
convert_nvm_to_ply_with_normalization: run the script to convert an NVM file to PLY with point cloud normalization enabled
convert_nvm_to_ply_filter_tracks: run the script to convert an NVM file to PLY filtering points by minimum track length
convert_nvm_to_ply_custom_percentiles: run the script to convert an NVM file to PLY using custom normalization percentile bounds
convert_nvm_to_ply_without_normalization: run the script to convert an NVM file to PLY with normalization disabled
